description: Use this when the user asks who their lawmakers are, or wants North Carolina House or Senate members for a 5-digit ZIP. North Carolina only: returns the NC House and Senate districts and the public office pages of those members, with any public record of their position. Sends only the ZIP to the U.S. Census Bureau's public geocoder to find the ZIP area's center point. ZIPs can cross districts, so confirm with the official lookup.
name: find_my_lawmakers
title: Find my lawmakers by ZIP
